name: Service account client secret
description: The secret half of an Atlas service account's client ID and secret pair, used with the OAuth 2.0 client credentials flow to obtain Atlas Administration API access tokens.

blockers.summary: Body alphabet, length and checksum are not stated by any page read; only a truncated example is documented.
Only an issued secret would show the body grammar; desk research does not issue credentials.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed.
